about.title: One artist, one shop, pages made for quiet
about.lead: I am an individual artist who always dreamed of having a webshop of my own. Everything here — the site, the books, the little extras — is made and shared by me.
about.story: My main work is creative development: I build apps and websites for clients. Outside of that, I am always making art. I love cute characters, and I do not draw humans. Animals and little creatures feel more like home.
about.storyGrief: In July 2026, my dad passed away. Grief is large and hard to hold, and so many things suddenly felt out of my hands. Somewhere in that season I noticed people coloring on TikTok and Instagram. I tried it myself, bought a 320-piece Ohuhu set, and fell in love. Coloring gave me a small pocket of peace. I chose the colors, the vibe, the mood. For a while, the page was a world I could gently steer.
about.storyArt: Out of that feeling came a quiet idea: what if I made my own coloring books, with my own art? Hidden in the pages are soft moments and memories of my dad — creatures and scenes that nod to time we shared, without needing to say everything out loud.
about.storyMore: That is how {name} began. The name may still shift. The heart of it will not: hand-drawn books from one person, made for anyone who needs a soft place to sit with color.
about.alt: A cozy desk with markers, a candle, and an open coloring book
